message.content: The consensus among critics and audiences alike points to **“Parasite”** as the standout film of 2020. Directed by Bong Joon‑ho, the Korean dark‑comedy thriller not only swept the major awards—winning Best Picture at the 2020 Oscars (held in 2021)—but also captivated viewers worldwide with its sharp social commentary, masterful pacing, and genre‑blending storytelling. Its blend of suspense, humor, and poignant drama made it a cultural touchstone and earned it a place at the top of many year‑end lists.
